scope: Read-only review of PR91 social metadata reader, context builder, real cycle wiring and SQL compatibility; independent temporary SDK boundary probes.
status: PASS for scoped review and probes; no new confirmed defect in social_status or buildSocialBriefContext
verified_by_inspection: Owner comes from server context, fixed SQL projection and equality filter, row owner validation includes sentinel.
UUID cursor ordering, excessive row count, duplicate row IDs and duplicate account platforms rejected; account platform uniqueness matches current SQL UNIQUE(user_id, platform).
Migration003 revokes client writes to social accounts/posts; migration004 preserves server-owned binding evidence.
Context is prepared before inference, preserves unavailable and partial resources; simulation/mock/unknown modes do not enable the preload.
Brief-dependent privateTrace remains enabled and the latest model admission occurs after context preparation.
Only UUIDs, enumerated values, booleans, validated dates and constrained provider receipt identifiers enter this metadata projection; no free account/content/raw error fields.

cases: Positive control: valid SDK response produces read metadata
Noncooperative fetch never returns headers: reader settles and aborts signal
Valid headers plus incomplete JSON body: reader settles and aborts signal
Headers returned after timeout do not cause late accepted metadata
Malformed UTF-8 in receipt field is rejected after SDK decoding
Foreign sentinel via SDK does not produce items or pagination evidence
probe_execution.overlap_note: Positive control and foreign sentinel are deliberate controls and overlap prior cases; the four transport/decoder probes add real SDK boundary coverage. Do not add this count to the full suite as a single global run.
probe_execution.initial_harness_error: First attempt imported mocks API by an absolute path, so Vitest collected zero tests; temporary config switched to globals. Initial log retained as sdk-boundaries.log; subsequent five-case run passed, then final six-case run included the positive control.

graph.query: No process result because FTS disabled; not used as proof of no callers.
graph.context: buildSocialBriefContext found exactly; dynamic execute references include imprecise candidates. Direct source/test reads used for caller validation.
graph.additional_result: Existing durable private-results path and consultation-host composition located; read-only exact source inspection confirmed consumption rather than treating registration as an implementation.

remaining_limitations.summary: The advertising prompt asks for web_search then PDF, but a single model decision precedes the complete tool loop. Search results from that cycle cannot inform already-decided PDF parameters.
remaining_limitations.reproduction_kind: Direct control/data flow inspection; no provider/model call

remaining_limitations.summary: The real Supabase transport has no explicit streamed response-byte cap in this reader. SQL row limit and fixed projections bound ordinary data; validations happen after SDK JSON decoding. No practical exploit or production oversized response was established.

No live database, real account, model behavior against prompt injection, provider health or production effect was exercised. Stream cancellation fixtures deliberately ignore transport abort; the reader can bound its waiting but cannot force remote cancellation.

research_consumption_found.flow: runModelConsultation retrieves explicitly requested public queries/URLs, collects sources, builds a bounded modelSources projection, then sends that projection to proposal/critique/synthesis model calls.
evidence: consultation.ts:301-313 context consumed by model calls
research_consumption_found.composition: karta/src/claude/consultation-host.ts wires createConnectedResearchClient into runModelConsultation under the existing durable admission/budget store.
research_consumption_found.activation_limit: Host requires configured accounts, valid policy, account resources and non-simulated model. No such account or provider was activated or exercised by this audit. This is a separate explicit consultation path, not the static advertising tool loop.

research_consumption_found.flow: knowledge_search results for custom agents can be projected and persisted by persistPrivateToolResult, then up to three server-owned result IDs selected by the owner are loaded and inserted into a later chat model request.
evidence: tests/creator-chat-authorization.test.mjs:428 selected server results reach exactly one model call
research_consumption_found.activation_limit: Explicit later-message selection, not automatic chaining in the original run. knowledge_search and quantum_simulate only; web_search is not a persisted private-tool result in this path.
